product_overview: EduReach is a web-based college help desk assistant that provides students with an informational homepage and an AI chatbot for answering college-related questions. The experience is designed to be simple, fast, and easy to use from a single public entry point.
core_goals: Browse college information from the homepage
Receive relevant AI-generated answers in a chat conversation
Continue the conversation with follow-up questions

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Users can view college information sections on the homepage and learn about the college from a single public page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the homepage -> View college information sections -> Learn about the college

features.name: College Chatbot
features.description: Users can open the chat interface from the homepage, ask college-related questions, and receive AI responses in an ongoing conversation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the chat interface -> Type a question -> Submit the question -> See the AI response in the chat history
Navigate to / -> Open the chat interface -> Type a follow-up question -> Submit the question -> See another AI response in the same conversation
Navigate to / -> Open the chat interface -> Submit an empty question -> See an input validation message

routes.description: College homepage with multiple informational sections and a chatbot
